name: Zonmi-chan: Meat Pie of the Dead
description:
A heartwarming splatter comedy about a zombie in love!

Zonmi-chan is a clumsy, careless, but cute girl. Sometimes she takes a bite out of the guy she likes. Oh, that's right, Zonmi-chan is a zombie girl.

(Source: Neft Film via ANN)

The episode was shown at AnimeJapan 2016 at the booth of Neft Film. The company plans to fund future episodes through crowdfunding. Neft Films uploaded the episode to YouTube on April 5, 2016.
